findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "crisis_resources" stacks urgency/override words (urgent, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: needs_near, gatherings_tonight, where_can_i_serve_publicly, cross_references · Private data: find_churches_near, church, communities_to_join, heritage_lookup, pray_for_someone, hear_the_kingdom_pray, body_today, saint_of_the_day, gatherings_tonight, where_can_i_serve_publicly, kingdom_protocol_lookup · Public sink: find_gatherings_near, pray_for_someone, a_prayer_for, testimonies · Destructive: kingdom_protocol_lookup, journey_next_steps.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: needs_near, gatherings_tonight, where_can_i_serve_publicly, cross_references · Private data: find_churches_near, church, communities_to_join, heritage_lookup, pray_for_someone, hear_the_kingdom_pray, body_today, saint_of_the_day, gatherings_tonight, where_can_i_serve_publicly, kingdom_protocol_lookup · Public sink: find_gatherings_near, pray_for_someone, a_prayer_for, testimonies · Destructive: kingdom_protocol_lookup, journey_next_steps

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
